authored_prior_components: bounded native broker and earlier outer runners
ancestry.independence_limit: This is a Source-backed diagnosis by an original control author, not an independent Source certificate of that control. Root alone executed and admitted the retained actuals.

generic_input_boundary: Read the declared target, full current compiled guards, all admitted exported ground interfaces and currently recursively justified rows. No c3 predicates, axiom names, source node IDs, row route, proof word or family binding may be hardcoded or imported from the historical traces.
one_change: Replace scalar cycle-blind backward-distance relevance with a contextual positive-cost AND-receptor support potential for ordering existing validated choices. No new cluster generator, marking, primitive, lemma template or pruning rule is part of this proposal.
point_integration: Use the score only after Graph has selected a genuine branch point under the unchanged global dead/forced/earliest-generation scheduler.

Rerank the existing validated Join item pool and/or incident alternatives through an explicitly declared mapping. Do not ask the scorer to replace graph domains, certify singleton/EOF, choose a later generation, bulk-place a cluster or exclude an alternative.

Preserve arbitrary sampled proposals, every original incident fallback alternative, each constituent legality/update/rollback, full literal model and final fresh native/point checks. No learned pruning or RL credit.
potential_definition: Build finite formula-level hyperedges from the unchanged admitted command/interface data. Every ordered premise of an MP or block remains a joint requirement. Keep interface provenance and port ordering even where scoring later ignores reference multiplicity.

A legal zero-read command can supply only its literal output. In particular instantiate and equality transport supply implication licences, not their operand or consequent facts. Universal generalization requires its actual body prerequisite and existing scope policy.

Seed zero cost only from actually complete recursively justified current rows. Admitted zero-premise commands have positive row cost. Compute a bounded least positive-cost support relaxation from those seeds; cyclic dependencies alone never establish a free seed.

Use a declared finite row-cost combination such as one plus the sum of required support estimates. This is a heuristic: shared subderivations, references, row capacity and scope may make it inaccurate. It is not an admissible lower bound or independent proof checker.

For a candidate/validated row-cluster projection, credit only additional fully completed recursively justified outputs, then compare marginal target-support reduction. Unfilled receptors, arbitrary partial samples and duplicate known outputs receive no invented fact credit. Unknown/infinite/overbudget scoring falls back to a stable declared ordering.

prospective_experiment.charge: Charge support graph construction, relaxation, candidate scoring, cluster validation, full model acquisition, source custody, rollback, native/point verification, serialization and transport.
prospective_experiment.fixed_problem: Same c3 assertion and any separately frozen new benchmark cases; same 12 rows, two syntax rounds, complete native registry/library, primitive grammar and common completed point model. Compact storage and shared result Reader are fixed engineering configuration, not new treatment factors.
prospective_experiment.interpretation: If both search methods improve, that supports a generic proof-search heuristic contribution rather than a geometry-specific advantage. A point-only gain would still require causal ordering/essential-cluster evidence and replication. One c3 observation establishes neither speed superiority nor generalization. No RL is introduced.
prospective_experiment.limits: Keep the coherent current 180-second whole-work, 210-second terminal, 1-GiB conservative aggregate and 128-MiB output envelope; nominal search 30 seconds/5000 method-specific extensions or placements unless Root prospectively chooses a new coherent declaration before any outcomes. No retries or outcome-dependent increase.
prospective_experiment.primary_endpoint: A fresh whole Native-accepted and full point-verified final proof within the complete declared resource profile. Outside-profile proof data remain diagnostic.

symbolic_integration: Apply the same support potential to already legal yielded row candidates, retaining all original skeleton k, basis variant v, interface modes, strict-prior ordered source tuples and exact-word duplicates/padding.
Keep novel-first or other stable lexical tie policy prospectively explicit. The heuristic is ordering only; no dominance quotient, new rule or prefix rejection.
